items.text: Caleb Williams OUT Grade 2 hamstring (3-4 weeks per Schefter/Rap); Case Keenum expected to start MNF vs Eagles; Bagent cleared but not starting.
items.implication: Bears offense downgrade multi-week; skill players volume/role shift under Keenum.
items.opportunity: Rome Odunze, DJ Moore, Luther Burden, Colston Loveland, D'Andre Swift higher floor/ceiling relative.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT thigh/quad late vs Lions; MRI expected; ruled out quickly after red-zone carry.
items.why: Grabbed thigh, slow to rise; ETR post-game watch.
items.implication: Miss time possible; Jets RB depth thin.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT ankle injury early vs Bucs; did not return after Q1 reception.
De'Von Achane ruled OUT knee (non-contact); Dolphins coach Hafley 'does not sound very optimistic' on severity; further testing.
items.why: Left early Q1; major concern postgame.
items.implication: Extended absence likely; handcuff/backup elevation critical.
items.opportunity: RB committee or Ollie Gordon/Wright (if healthy) surge in carries/targets.

items.text: Zay Flowers active vs Cowboys after GTD/hamstring; Berry would start him over Bateman despite risk/pitch count potential.
items.why: Pregame workout cleared him; limited snaps expected (20-30) but elite talent.
items.implication: Startable WR2/3 with upside if volume materializes; reverse Bateman/Andrews beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if limited but explosive (postgame 5/6 for 84 + rush).

items.text: Dallas Goedert OUT MCL sprain (few weeks expected); missed practice all week; ruled out MNF.

ETR Sunday injuries watch: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (ham), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb dislocation + McMillan knee), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand returned), Spears (ankle), Bech (broken forearm IR).
items.why: Comprehensive post-slate monitoring aligned with Schefter/Rap.
items.implication: Monitor MRI/tests Mon for ROS/waivers; beneficiaries reverse if returns.
items.opportunity: Backups/handcuffs for OUT players (e.g. Etienne absence).

items.text: Puka Nacua inactive/OUT hip (prior Q/doubtful groin/hip flexor confusion) for SNF vs Broncos.
items.implication: Rams WR1 void; Davante Adams/others elevated.

items.text: Mike Evans carted/OUT rib strain (or oblique); full eval Monday; painful injury type.
items.why: Left mid-game; Schefter confirmed OUT ribs.
items.implication: 49ers WR depth tested; may miss time.

items.text: With AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger), Levitan notes Jets WR depth: Wilson clear WR1 with high opportunity; Isaiah Williams etc; Sadiq hybrid slot/wide. Wilson projected 30%+ targets in good matchup.
items.why: Mitchell out + other absences; dome vs bad Lions secondary.
items.implication: Wilson must-start/high DFS; cheap volume WRs viable.
items.opportunity: Elevated target/route share for Wilson (and Williams).

items.text: ETR/Levitan initially projected Flowers OUT (team not counting on him); kept late Bateman/Andrews DFS swap open; later ACTIVE confirmed.
items.why: Hamstring; pregame workout positive despite limited practice.
items.implication: Update projections/lineups; high-end WR2 ROS if healthy.
items.opportunity: Snap share rebound for Lamar targets.

items.text: Levitan cash review: must-plays Gibbs (absurd role/home vs Jets, underpriced), Kenneth Walker (elite role vs weak MIA, salary steal), Garrett Wilson (30%+ targets setup); strong start YTD.
items.why: Projections/ceiling comps; usage/role edge over salary.
items.implication: Core cash builds around these; ROS confidence in roles.

items.text: Berry highlights Bhayshul Tuten via Trevor Lawrence kneel to set up Tuten TD; FantasyLife shoutout for support.
items.implication: Handcuff/stash or flex bump if role expands.

items.text: ETR AM report: Saquon Barkley, Devonta Smith, Brock Bowers, Jaylen Warren, Michael Pittman, Mike Evans (pre), Coker, Coleman EXPECTED TO PLAY; Parkinson trending.
items.implication: Start with confidence; no major role loss.
